leanpool.method: Independent line-anchored declaration scanner plus all-keyword crosscheck; legacy survey mask with identical regex matching optimized by AST rewrite to use offsets, not extractor mask implementation; sequential files, no Lean processes.
leanpool.nonanchored_examples_note: 70 of 71 examples retained; the omitted last item was independently checked at scripts/exposition/Extract.lean:479. Exactly 68 are genuine inline include/omit wrapper declarations.

initial_extraction_ledger_audit.note: Source declaration identity checked independently; this does not prove source compilation. Initial completed extraction before any focused repair.

reviewed_span_override_audit.method: Independent source-file hashes, source/proof hashes, byte-to-char declaration anchors, flat ()[]{} balanced assignment scan (ignoring custom angle notation), separately scanned next-command boundaries, and original-proof reinsertion. Equation const span additionally inspected as two explicit pattern branches. No Lean execution or kernel validation.

final_export_check.wrapper_policy: Root command wrappers retained separately; src and statement start at theorem declaration for both omit wrappers; original proof hashes unchanged.

cslib.method: Independent physlib_lexical declaration positions and broad masked-keyword crosscheck; source-only Python scan, no Lean invocation.

warmup_export_checks.note: Exact source-field comparison only; not kernel validation

arklib.method: Independent physlib_lexical declaration positions and broad masked-keyword crosscheck; source-only Python scan, no Lean invocation.
arklib.direct_sorry_count_method: crosscheck of extracted inventory contains_sorry fields; full-source independent lexical scan found 217 sorry/admit tokens, including non-theorem definitions.

putnambench.method: Independent physlib_lexical declaration positions and broad masked-keyword crosscheck; source-only Python scan, no Lean invocation.
putnambench.version_info_note: Arena benchmark.py explicitly defines PutnamBench version_info SHA values as mathlib4 release commits, not PutnamBench source commits.
putnambench.source_shape_note: lean4/src has 672 problem theorem declarations, each containing sorry. Extra 2 Lean files are lakefile.lean and check_docstrings.lean. Numeric-solution rewriting only inlines answer abbreviations; it does not add proofs.

audit_scope: Pinned tracked Lean source, theorem/lemma declarations only. Counts do not establish elaboration, axiom cleanliness, or heartbeat costs. No source files changed; no dependencies built.
